topic:beliefs.title: Core beliefs in Islam
keyPoints: Church weddings and funerals: summarises Dar al-Ifta and AMJA (may attend), SeekersGuidance Hanafi (gathering only) and IslamQA (strict); check each summary
Named SeekersGuidance answers: Jamir Meah (statues), Ilyas Patel (prasad), Abdullah Anik Misra (karma), Faraz Rabbani (yoga quote), Irshaad Sedick (smudging)
Creed claims: Quran names 25 prophets; prophets protected from major sins but small errors possible; angels made from light; Mika'il over rain and provision
Amulets: says most scholars (per Islamweb) forbid even Quran-only taweez; a SeekersGuidance Shafi'i answer allows 3 conditions; cites Abu Dawud 3883
Hadith to check: Muslim 121, 2188, 2200, 2230 (prayer unaccepted 40 nights), 2261a (spit left 3 times); Bukhari 1385, 2276, 3432, 3448, 4485
Cites a 2025 Yaqeen survey (618 US converts: 60% raised Christian, ~19% no religion) and a 2013 Psychiatrist paper; 911 then 9-8-8 order is correct
preCheckFlags: Quotes 7:156 ('My mercy encompasses all things') but quran-7-156 is not in sourceIds (the entry exists in sources.json)
Headings lead with Arabic: 'Tawhid: the oneness of God', 'Qadar: understanding divine decree'; card 'Dua and dhikr' (nav: 'Supplication and remembrance')

topic:character.title: Islamic character and ethics
keyPoints: Cites Bukhari 3559 for 'The best among you are those who have the best manners and character'
Sunnah habits: Bukhari 5376 (bismillah, right hand, eat what is nearest), Bukhari 6311 (wudu, right side, bedtime dua), Quran 24:61 (greet on entering)
Quotes 2:153, 14:7, 4:58, 17:23, 49:12 and 68:4 and cites 113:5; check each translation of meaning
Uncited seerah claims: called Al-Amin before prophethood, children on his back in prayer, prayed for Taif, forgave Makkah, never refused anyone
Anger advice (go quiet, sit down, make wudu, seek refuge) has no hadith reference; check which reports support it and their grading
Says a parent's request against the faith is declined politely while still treating them well; calls keeping kinship ties a serious obligation

topic:community.title: Building your Muslim community
keyPoints: Lists 13 Canadian convert programmes with days, times, emails and addresses (e.g. Islam Care Centre, Wednesdays 6:00 pm, 375 Somerset St. W), checked 23 Sept 2026
Confirm the listed masjids and bodies are mainstream Sunni: Islam Care Centre, MAC Masjid Toronto, IIT, Markham, IAOS Regina, MIA, Markaz-Ul-Islam, BCMA and others
Recommends Reddit r/converts, Facebook and Discord groups, New Muslim Academy, Khalil Center and the Naseeha helpline
Same-sex attraction: says some online groups teach outside mainstream Sunni scholarship; points to FAQ, a scholar, Khalil Center, Naseeha; 911 then 9-8-8
Cites 2025 Yaqeen survey of 618 US converts: 78% made friends at a mosque, about 40% lonely in Ramadan and 42% on Eid
Says Islam does not ask converts to cut off hostile family; keep reaching out and make du'a for them
preCheckFlags: Quotes 29:8 ('And We have enjoined upon man goodness to parents') but no source for Quran 29:8 exists in sourceIds or in sources.json

topic:dua-and-dhikr.title: Supplication and remembrance (dua and dhikr)
keyPoints: Says dua can be made in your own language; transmitted duas and dhikr should be learned from sources with a Quran or hadith reference
Says an unsourced dua may be used in your own words but not passed on as Prophetic until someone qualified checks it
Crisis line: 'If you have thoughts of self-harm... call 9-1-1, call or text 9-8-8, or contact a qualified clinician' (911 first, as required)
Sources are general (Quran.com, Sunnah.com, Darussalam); related resource is the Fortress of the Muslim dua book

topic:end-of-life-decisions.title: End-of-life decisions
keyPoints: MAID: says request must be free of outside pressure, can be withdrawn anytime; mental-illness-only cases ineligible until 17 March 2027; confirm current law
FCNA (Shaykh Mustafa Umar): stopping treatment that only prolongs dying, incl. life support and feeding tube, is allowed; euthanasia forbidden
Organ donation: FCNA permits with consent, no sale, family consulted; rejects brain death as death; bars donating reproductive organs
Cites AMJA fatwa 1881 (quoting the Muslim World League Fiqh Council) and fatwa 76781 (any religion, 'one narrow exception')
Nova Scotia deemed consent at 19+ without a registered decision; check if the Act's residency and capacity conditions should be stated
Says an Ontario coroner's autopsy decision is binding; Speak Up substitute decision maker; 911 then 9-8-8 order is correct

topic:family-and-identity.title: Family and identity
keyPoints: Says changing your name is not automatically required; a name with a good or neutral meaning can usually be kept
Says there is no set timeline for telling family; waiting is fine where hostility, housing pressure or emotional harm is possible
Unsafe family pressure: refers to 'trusted local Muslims, professional support, or appropriate services' without naming 911 or a Canadian service
Script: 'I love you and I want us to stay close. I am still learning...'; says you may decline alcohol, pork, hostile debates, invasive questions
Related resources to confirm: WhyIslam, AboutIslam new Muslims section, Yaqeen 'Becoming Muslim' report

topic:fasting.title: Fasting and Ramadan
keyPoints: Rulings: Hanafi kiss-to-ejaculation breaks fast; kaffarah Hanafi (eating, drinking, intercourse) vs Shafi'i (intercourse); pre-Shahada days not owed
Fidyah: says Islamic Relief Canada lists CAD 15 per missed fast for 2026; zakat al-fitr about 3 kg of staple food per person (Yaqeen)
Diabetes Canada: lists who must not fast, see team 1-3 months before, type 1 break fast if ketones above 0.6 mmol/L; well-controlled type 1 not advised
Medicines: IIFA 1997 list; inhalers (Dar al-Ifta: no break; SeekersGuidance Shafi'i: breaks); nasal sprays and blood tests differ by school
Eating disorders use the illness exemption; cites British Dietetic Association and NEDIC helpline 1-866-633-4220
Hadith: Bukhari 1923, 1927, 1933, 953; Abu Dawud 2356; Tirmidhi 747, 761; Nasa'i 2420; Muslim 1164. Toronto fasts about 11 to 16+ hours
preCheckFlags: Headings lead with Arabic: 'Suhoor and iftar: practical tips' and 'Eid al-Fitr: the celebration' (site label elsewhere: 'The festival after Ramadan (Eid al-Fitr)')

topic:five-pillars.title: The five pillars of Islam
keyPoints: Cites Bukhari 8 and Muslim 16a ('Islam is built on five'); says Bukhari 8 puts Hajj before fasting and Ibn Umar corrects the order in Muslim 16a
Cites Bukhari 1395 and Muslim 19a (Mu'adh to Yemen: Shahada, then prayer, then zakat) and Quran 20:14
Says schools differ on whether ghusl after Shahada is required; suggests one rak'ah with short remembrance before Al-Fatihah is learned
Zakat: 'usually 2.5 percent', due when savings stay above the nisab for a full lunar year; the home you live in is not counted
Hajj once in a lifetime for those able (Quran 3:97, Muslim 1337); fasting excuses listed: ill, elderly, travelling, pregnant, nursing, menstruating
Cites the hadith of Jibril (Muslim 8a) for the six articles of faith

topic:grief-and-loss.title: Grief and loss
keyPoints: Mourning: cites Bukhari 1280 (no more than three days except for a husband); Shaykh Yusuf Badat (Mathabah) limits it to outward mourning
Widow's iddah four months and ten days (Quran 2:234); says schools differ on leaving home, work and adornment
Duas and transliterations: 'Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un' (2:156), Muslim 918a, 963a ('Allahumma ighfir lahu warhamhu'), 920a, Ibn Majah 1498, 17:24
Lists 'harming yourself' among mourning acts Muslims avoid (with wailing, tearing clothes); check it cannot read as shaming self-harm; Bukhari 1303
Warning signs from Sultan and Awad (Yaqeen): cannot manage daily life, hopelessness, wishing to be dead; 911 then 9-8-8 order is correct
Says how women visit graves is discussed by scholars; points to the FAQ on praying for relatives who were not Muslim
preCheckFlags: Heading 'Duas for a Muslim who has died' and card label 'Duas and dhikr' lead with Arabic instead of plain English

topic:halal-living.title: Halal living
keyPoints: Handshakes: says most of the four schools forbid non-mahram handshakes (Muslim 1866b, AMJA); Dar al-Ifta allows one without desire
Music: most of the four schools restrict instruments except the duff; Bukhari 5590's chain is discussed; al-Ghazali and Dar al-Ifta allow clean music
Named fatwas: Sedick/Rabbani (streaming), Badhib and Dremali (photos), al-Sawy 4170, Hatem al-Haj 1774, al-Qudah 2066, Zarabozo 86975 (car insurance)
Finance facts: FCAC 21-day grace, BNPL 0% to 35%, federal student loans interest-free since 1 April 2023, OSAP Ontario part charges interest, CPP over $3,500
Mortgages: a SeekersGuidance answer says moving to Islamic financing is 'strongly advised or even required'; Dar al-Ifta allows a bank loan as murabaha
CFIA: halal claims must name the certifier; says HMA rejects machine-slaughtered chicken many scholars accept; CAMH warns alcohol withdrawal can be dangerous

topic:masjid-and-community.title: Masjid and community
keyPoints: Says many Canadian masjids are charities or non-profits run by elected volunteer boards that employ the imam
Says the CRA charity list shows registration status, contact information, general activities and financial information
Says CRA takes reports of charity-money misuse but not everyday disputes, and sends no updates to the reporter
Warning signs: isolating you, constant shaming, demanding secrecy, pressure toward marriage; related resources ICNA New Muslim Guide and WhyIslam

topic:menstruation-and-worship.title: Menstruation and worship: a guide for sisters
keyPoints: Says prayers missed during a period are not made up but Ramadan fasts are (Muslim 335c, Bukhari 321); prayer may be owed at the start or end of a prayer time
Intimacy: only intercourse pauses (2:222, Muslim 302); Hanafi, Maliki, Shafi'i ask a navel-to-knee barrier (Abu Dawud 212, Bukhari 302); Hanbali allows all else
Quran: Hanafi/Shafi'i no recitation aloud; Maliki allows it; AMJA and IslamQA allow from memory; an AMJA scholar says a phone app is not a mushaf
Says most schools bar staying in the main prayer hall, differing on passing through; classrooms and halls may not count as masjid
End of period: white discharge or dryness; schools differ on brown or yellow. Istihadah: Hanafi excused-person rule, one wudu per prayer time
Hadith: Bukhari 305 ('ordained for all the daughters of Adam'), 297, 324 (Eid), 306; Muslim 298a ('Your menstruation is not in your hand')
preCheckFlags: Card label 'Wudu and ghusl guide' leads with Arabic; the site nav calls the tool 'Washing before prayer (wudu and ghusl)'

topic:modesty.title: Modesty
keyPoints: Awrah: men navel to and including the knee (Hanafi), women all but face and hands before non-mahram men (SeekersGuidance); Quran 24:31, 33:59
Beard: Hanafi wajib at a fist's length, shaving prohibited; Maliki unlawful; Shafi'i recommended, shaving disliked (Bukhari 5892, SeekersGuidance)
Fitrah: Muslim 261a (ten acts) and Muslim 258 (forty-night limit); says the list applies to women apart from beard and moustache
Says Ontario creed policy s.10.2 requires accommodating a religious beard short of undue hardship (bearded Sikh guard example)
Mahram: says non-Muslim relatives remain mahram (SeekersGuidance Hanafi, Shafi'i); Hanafi allows travel with a non-Muslim mahram; Bukhari 5232, 5233
Says men do not wear gold or silk; clothing must not be see-through or tight; stepfather is mahram only once the marriage is consummated (4:23)
preCheckFlags: Man's mahram list says it mirrors the woman's but omits his father's wife (stepmother), made unmarriageable in Quran 4:22; only 4:23 is cited

topic:new-muslim-basics.title: New Muslim basics
keyPoints: Cites Bukhari 4993 (Aisha: rulings like the alcohol ban came after verses on Paradise and the Fire) for gradual change
Cites Bukhari 69, 39 and 6464, Tirmidhi 2453 (hasan), Quran 2:185 and 22:78 on ease and moderation
Says the required list 'usually starts with belief, the five daily prayers, the Ramadan fast... and staying away from what is clearly forbidden'
Says knowing which prayer you are about to pray is the intention (niyyah); cites Bukhari 1 and Bukhari 56 (spending on family)
Says name changes, food rulings, clothing arguments and Arabic fluency can wait, but gradual learning is no permission to set aside prayer
Related resources to confirm: New Muslim Academy, WhyIslam and the book 'Welcome to Islam'

topic:prayer.title: Understanding prayer (salah)
keyPoints: Transliterations: 'Subhana Rabbiyal Adheem', 'Sami'a Allahu liman hamidah', 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd', 'Subhana Rabbiyal A'la', 'Rabbighfir li'
Covering: men navel to knee (Hanafi counts the knee), a shoulder (Bukhari 359, Hanbali); women all but face and hands, hair (Abu Dawud 641), Hanafi feet
Travel: Hanafi about 77 km and under 15 days, qasr wajib; Shafi'i about 79-80 km and under 4 days; AMJA no fixed days; Hanafi repeats seated plane prayer
Voluntary: Muslim 728a, Tirmidhi 415 (12 rak'ahs); witr Bukhari 998, 990; night prayer max 11 (Bukhari 1147); duha Muslim 720; tarawih Bukhari 1129
Says pre-Islam prayers are not owed; missed prayers made up on remembering (Bukhari 597); dhikr in place of Al-Fatihah (Abu Dawud 832, Hasan)
Qibla: Tirmidhi 344 'between the east and the west is qibla' graded Sahih by Darussalam; says a few degrees off is no reason to repeat
preCheckFlags: Calls Friday (Jumuah) prayer at the mosque 'encouraged'; it is obligatory for adult resident men without excuse (Quran 62:9), and the page never says so

topic:prophet-muhammad.title: Prophet Muhammad and his life story (seerah)
keyPoints: Says Muhammad is the final prophet and that loving him means honouring and following him, not worshipping him
Seerah map: Makkah period on tawhid, revelation and patience under pressure; Madinah period on community, treaties and mercy in leadership
Defines Sunnah (guidance, practice, approvals, character) and hadith (reports); says scholars check chains, wording and context before a ruling
Quotes Imam Malik: 'a person who passes on everything he hears is not safe' (Sahih Muslim, Introduction 10)
Advises checking AI-generated hadith on Sunnah.com, with its grade, before believing or sharing
Recommends Yaqeen seerah collection, SeekersGuidance seerah, New Muslim Academy and the book 'Being Muslim'
preCheckFlags: Heading 'Sunnah in daily life' leads with Arabic instead of plain English

topic:purification.title: Purification in Islam
keyPoints: Ghusl on becoming Muslim: 'required in some views and recommended in others'; cites Abu Dawud 355
Wudu broken by restroom, gas, deep sleep, unconsciousness (Bukhari 135); says bleeding, vomiting and touching private parts differ by school
Tayammum: Hanafi two strikes to the elbows vs one strike to the wrists (Bukhari 338); Quran 4:43 and 5:6
Najasah: Shafi'i heavy/light/moderate; dog vessel washed 7 times (Muslim 279a); baby boy's urine sprinkled (Bukhari 223); non-wine alcohol not impure (Hanafi)
Says most scholars allow reading a Quran app without wudu 'since you are not touching the text itself'; socks wiped 24 h resident, 72 h travelling
Nail polish blocks wudu; istinja paper then water best (Hanafi), water required if mess spreads beyond the exit; incontinence excused-person rule
preCheckFlags: Headings lead with Arabic: 'Wudu: the washing before prayer', 'Ghusl: the full body wash', 'Tayammum: dry purification'

topic:questions-and-doubts.title: Questions and doubts
keyPoints: Says whispers and unwanted thoughts do not take a person out of Islam; cites Muslim 132a, Bukhari 2528, Bukhari 3276 and Quran 16:106
Quotes Dr. Asim Yusuf: 'A person who fears not being Muslim is by definition a Muslim'; transliterations 'A'udhu billahi min ash-shaytan ir-rajim', 'Amantu billah'
OCD: quotes CAMH on fear of blasphemous thoughts and CBT plus medication; quotes Dr. Jibran Khokhar (Yaqeen); refers to Khalil Center and Naseeha
Faith dips: Hanzala hadith (Muslim 2750a), Tirmidhi 2453, Bukhari 6464; CAMH depression sign is low mood most days for over two weeks
Survey claims: 2025 Yaqeen (23% of US converts thought of leaving over doubts); 2018 Chouhoud (Muslims' actions drove doubt more than teachings)
Recommends seven Yaqeen papers (Nazir Khan, Muntasir Zaman x2, Brown and Ali, Suleiman Hani, Bouguenaya on evolution, Tahir et al.)
preCheckFlags: Card label 'Dua and dhikr' leads with Arabic; the site nav calls the tool 'Supplication and remembrance (dua and dhikr)'

topic:quran.title: The Quran: a beginner's guide
keyPoints: Says the four schools require wudu to touch the Arabic mushaf; names al-Hasan al-Basri, Ibn Sirin and Ibn Hazm as allowing it; AMJA advises wudu
Says the Hanafi school asks wudu to touch a printed translation while the Shafi'i, Maliki and Hanbali schools do not
Says The Clear Quran translates 56:79 as about the purified angels
Disposal: burying, shredding or respectful burning of unreadable pages; cites Uthman burning other copies (Bukhari 4987)
Hanafi answer (SeekersGuidance): phone with a closed Quran app may go into the bathroom; do not touch on-screen verses without wudu
Recommends The Clear Quran, Quran.com, Mishary Alafasy's recitation and Bayyinah TV

topic:thinking-about-islam.title: Thinking about Islam?
keyPoints: Says the Shahada needs no fee, witnesses, name change or Arabic to count before Allah; witnesses matter only for records such as marriage
Salman Younas (SeekersGuidance) sets out three views on belief without saying the Shahada; says Abdul-Rahim Reasat follows the third
Why Islam Canada form needs a street address (no PO boxes), sent by ICNA Canada and GainPeace.org; Furqaan Project treats contact details as consent
Kids Help Phone 1-800-668-6868 or text CONNECT to 686868; 911 in an emergency
Quotes 2:256 ('no compulsion') and 28:56 ('Allah guides whom He wills'); says 99% of 618 US converts in a 2025 Yaqeen survey studied Islam first
Recommends The Clear Quran (Dr. Mustafa Khattab), Quran.com, WhyIslam and Yaqeen Institute

topic:why-muslims-differ.title: Why Muslims differ: schools and labels
keyPoints: States site policy: sources and masjid directory are Sunni, no Shia or Ahmadiyya institutions, and this is 'not a judgement on any person'
Says Amman Message point 1 names the Ja'fari and Zaydi Shia schools as Muslim and protects true Salafi thought and genuine Sufism from takfir
Says mainstream Sunni scholarship, incl. Dar al-Ifta, places Ahmadiyya belief in a prophet after Muhammad outside Islam (Quran 33:40)
Cites Bukhari 7352 (the judge's two rewards) and Quran 4:59; Amman Message point 2 (difference a mercy) and point 3 (fatwa qualifications)
Calls Salafi, Sufi, Deobandi, Barelvi and Tablighi movements within Sunni Islam; says takfir belongs only to trained scholars
Cites Dr. Emad Hamdeh and Dr. Nazir Khan (Yaqeen, updated 22 July 2024); says IslamQA is supervised by Shaykh Muhammad Salih al-Munajjid
preCheckFlags: Card label 'Salah companion' leads with Arabic; the site nav calls the tool 'Learn to pray (salah)'

topic:wills-and-inheritance.title: Wills and inheritance
keyPoints: One-third rule (Bukhari 2742): debts first, up to a third to non-heirs; FCNA allows more than a third for a child in your care if heirs agree
Says the four schools bar inheritance between Muslim and non-Muslim (Bukhari 6764, Muslim 1614); IslamWeb names Mu'adh, Ibn al-Musayyab, Ibn Taymiyyah as dissenting
Ontario: dependant support claims usually within 6 months of the estate trustee being named; spouse's equalization election within 6 months of death
BC: the named executor has first right over burial, and a written burial preference in a will binds unless unreasonable
Says Steps to Justice (CLEO) offers a free guided tool for a simple Ontario will and powers of attorney
Quotes Quran 4:11 'after the fulfilment of bequests and debts' and cites 2:180 on making a will; check the translation wording

guide:family-and-friends.title: Family and friends guide
keyPoints: Says the family's choice of faith is not the convert's burden; quotes Quran 28:56 and cites 2:256 and 88:21-22
Says scholars describe the duty to invite family to Islam differently and the guide does not settle it; you may decline debates and street dawah
Safety: if someone might hurt you, take documents or evict you, contact a professional, crisis line or shelter first; no number is given
Grief: cites Awad and Sultan (Yaqeen); mentions Yaqub's grief and the Prophet weeping for Ibrahim with no verse or hadith reference
Scripts: 'I don't eat pork or drink alcohol now'; family events with another religion's worship are referred to a local imam

guide:first-masjid-visit.title: First masjid visit guide
keyPoints: Twelve hadith cited inline: Bukhari 510, 444, 934, 855, 900, 707; Muslim 499a, 713a, 875c, 564a; Abu Dawud 698, 1118; check wording and grades
Masjid duas: 'Allahumma iftah li abwaba rahmatik' and 'Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik' (Muslim 713a), called recommended, not required
Friday sermon: says scholars differ on praying two rak'ahs during it (Muslim 875c); even saying 'be quiet' is wrong (Bukhari 934)
Women may attend (Bukhari 900); 'scholars discuss the conditions and where it is better for a woman to pray'
Access: Deaf Muslims of Canada books ASL interpreters and trains them; ISDHH (US) interprets khutbah in ASL; confirm both are current and suitable
preCheckFlags: Cites 12 hadith (Bukhari 510, Muslim 713a, Abu Dawud 1118 etc.) and Quran 2:286, none in sourceIds (only 4 ids); matching entries exist in sources.json

guide:work-and-school.title: Work and school guide
keyPoints: Quebec: says Bill 9 (assent 2 April 2026, SQ 2026 c 6) bars religious symbols in listed roles and prayer in public-body places incl. CEGEPs and universities
Says the Supreme Court of Canada heard a laicity challenge in March 2026, ruling unchecked; consolidated law as of 1 Sept 2026, checked 23 Sept
Federal: CHRA complaint within one year of the last act; Ontario creed policy: undue hardship limited to cost, outside funding, health and safety
Jobs: serving alcohol or pork not allowed (SeekersGuidance), selling alcohol forbidden by agreement (AMJA, Tirmidhi 1295); may keep working while searching
Combining prayers for work: AMJA allows for real hardship temporarily; Hanafi only late/early praying. Khalwa: Tirmidhi 2165; mixed work allowed with need
Campus: U of T Multi-Faith Centre at 569 Spadina Crescent, no faith-leader letter; UBC asks 14 days notice; NCCM guide dated 2019
preCheckFlags: Tirmidhi 1295, Tirmidhi 2165, Quran 5:2 and Quran 24:30-31 are cited inline but not in sourceIds; matching entries exist in sources.json
Related link 'Wudu with a headscarf' leads with Arabic instead of plain English

guide:identity-and-culture.title: Identity and culture guide
keyPoints: Says a name change is usually not required unless the name conflicts with Islamic belief or means something bad (WhyIslam)
Says whether the Friday sermon is in English is up to each masjid; check this against the schools' rules on Arabic in the khutbah
Calls thobe, shalwar kameez and abaya cultural styles; says scholars and masjids differ on the beard and on gender separation at events
Cites the Yaqeen convert report (culture vs religion, pumpkin pie at iftar) and Quran 30:22 and 49:13

guide:relationships-and-marriage-basics.title: Relationships and marriage basics
keyPoints: Says AMJA 21783 and SeekersGuidance call it consensus that a Muslim woman does not marry a non-Muslim man (2:221, 60:10); men may marry chaste Christians or Jews (5:5)
Says one SeekersGuidance teacher (2019) advises waiting at least a year after a partner's Shahada before nikah; cohabiting couples told to sleep apart
Divorce: talaq and iddah (2:228-232, 65:1), khul' (Bukhari 5273, AMJA Family Code art. 143); civil divorce ends only the civil contract (art. 129)
Divorce Act s.21.1(2)-(3) religious-barrier affidavit; Ontario religious arbitration has no legal effect (2006 Act); Wahb 2023: 14 of 15 fatwas
Numbers: Legal Aid Ontario 1-800-668-8258 (Mon-Fri 8:30-4:30 ET), Nisa Helpline 1-888-711-6472, Sakeenah 24/7 1-888-671-3446, 2-1-1, 911
Ontario: unmarried partners need not split property but may have a claim; Law Society Referral Service gives a free 30-minute consultation

guide:loneliness-and-belonging.title: Loneliness and belonging
keyPoints: Crisis wording: 911 in an emergency, then call or text 9-8-8 for thoughts of suicide (988.ca); check the phrase 'thoughts of hurting yourself'
Hope for Wellness Help Line for First Nations, Inuit and Metis, 24/7 at 1-855-242-3310
Programmes to confirm (checked 23 Sept 2026): Islam Care Centre Wednesdays 6:00 pm, MAC Convert Connect, London, Halifax, Winnipeg (MIA), BCMA
Yaqeen 2025 figures: about 40% lonely in Ramadan, 42% on Eid, 78% made friends at a mosque, 36% and 30.9% on doubt from being unwelcome or made inferior
Cites Jonathan Brown's Yaqeen paper on anti-Blackness, Quran 49:13 and a 2025 study of Black African Muslims in Montreal (Traore)

guide:healthy-community-signs.title: Signs of a healthy community
keyPoints: Quotes Ibn Sirin: 'This knowledge is religion, so carefully consider from whom you take your religion' (Sahih Muslim, Introduction 26)
Says the Canadian Council of Imams claims over 100 affiliated imams and an announced accreditation programme with no published criteria or register
Teacher checks: can name their teachers, backed by an institution with a public address, fair to other schools; do not pay strangers up front
Says the Yaqeen convert report encourages leaders to invite converts to share stories; advises saying no to filming before the Shahada

guide:halal-living-in-daily-life.title: Halal living in daily life
keyPoints: Kosher: says the Hanafi and Hanbali schools require God's name over each animal and the Shafi'i treat it as recommended; the Maliki view is not given
Says the Hanafi school permits non-pig animal rennet; hunting for sport not permitted; a Hanafi answer calls catch-and-release fishing impermissible
AMJA: avoid pork gelatin in medicine if an alternative exists, otherwise allowed; blood and organs allowed across religions with 'one narrow exception'
Illness: pray standing, sitting or lying as able; tayammum when water would harm; says not to stop a needed medicine while awaiting an answer
Says The Ottawa Hospital's prayer rooms are open all day and night with Friday Muslim prayers; Ontario LTC Residents' Bill of Rights covers religion

guide:modesty-and-clothing.title: Modesty and clothing
keyPoints: Says the four Sunni schools hold hijab obligatory for adult women (24:31, 33:59); any style covering hair, neck and head is fine (SeekersGuidance)
Calls the hijab figures (63% wear it; 46%, 30%, 24% by timing) a '2021' Yaqeen survey; its source entry is the 2025 report of 618 converts
Mixed gyms: Ilyas Patel (checked by Abdul-Rahim Reasat) says avoid where possible; AMJA's Main Khalid Al-Qudah allows with a lowered gaze
Swimming: men cover navel to past the knee; women permitted with conditions per Shaykh Anas al-Musa (women-only preferred, loose clothing)
Legal: Ontario creed policy s.10.2 on head coverings; passport, IRCC biometrics, Ontario licence and health card photos allow a head covering with face visible

guide:how-to-ask-for-help.title: How to ask for help
keyPoints: Says danger, thoughts of self-harm, abuse or a medical emergency go to emergency or crisis services first: call 911, or call or text 9-8-8
Describes 9-8-8 as for 'a mental health crisis'; 988.ca presents it as the suicide crisis helpline, so check the wording
Routing: imam or scholar for worship and halal; mental health professional for anxiety or trauma; rights office or lawyer for work, housing and documents
Kids Help Phone, Hope for Wellness and Naseeha are in sourceIds but not named in the text

guide:guide-for-mentors.title: Guide for mentors of new Muslims
keyPoints: If suicide or self-harm is mentioned: help them call 911 in an emergency or call or text 9-8-8, and reach clinical care; do not counsel a crisis alone
Recommends Sheikh Assim al-Hakeem's 1:04:14 video on the Prophet's prayer for mentors, noted as stricter and from one approach
Cites the 2025 Yaqeen report: approach Black converts about race-related experiences; boards should include diverse people or a convert representative
Referral map: scholar for rulings, marriage and divorce; clinician for trauma or self-harm; safety service for abuse or held documents; lawyer for immigration
Shahada handoff: no photos or announcements without clear permission; check family, housing, work and safety risks before anyone is told

guide:holidays-and-family-occasions.title: Holidays and family occasions
keyPoints: Christmas: SeekersGuidance Hanafi (Waseem Hussain) permits the family gathering; Islamweb and AMJA 77225 (Al-Qudah) stricter; Dar al-Ifta view summarised
Greetings: Dar al-Ifta allows congratulating; Jamaal Zarabozo advises not saying 'Merry Christmas' (AMJA 85952); AMJA 1533 calls accepting gifts a sunnah
Birthdays: AMJA 77128 and 1533 lenient vs AMJA 22801 (Salah Al-Sawy) and Muhammad Fayez Awad; Thanksgiving: Rabbani vs AMJA 76974 and 22994
Says no lenient scholarly source was found on Halloween; summarises Diwali (Farid Dingle) and Lunar New Year (MuslimSG/MUIS article) positions
Praying for a relative who died outside Islam: SeekersGuidance (no formal forgiveness) vs Dar al-Ifta (a child may ask forgiveness); Bukhari 1303
Cites Tirmidhi 2801 (Hasan, Darussalam) on tables with alcohol; says one wash removes pork impurity from pans (Hanafi); cites Bukhari 2620 and 31:15
preCheckFlags: Cites Quran 5:5 for the meat of Christians and Jews, but quran-5-5 is not in sourceIds (the entry exists in sources.json)

guide:red-flags-and-staying-safe.title: Red flags and staying safe
keyPoints: Numbers: Sakeenah 24/7 1-888-671-3446; Nisa Helpline +1 888 711 6472 (8 am to midnight ET, 14+); CAFC 1-888-495-8501 (Mon-Fri 10 am-4:45 pm ET)
More numbers: CRA charities 1-800-267-2384; ETA 416-617-4561 (call or text); Project ReSet 613-789-7418; Ottawa Police 613-236-1222; OPP 1-888-310-1122
Says registered charities do not accept cryptocurrency; confirm this matches the CAFC or CRA wording
Says everyone in Ontario is legally required to report a child at risk to a children's aid society
IRCC: no one can guarantee a visa; IRCC never asks for payment to personal accounts, emails from Gmail, takes payment by phone or starts chats on social media
Crisis order: 911 first in immediate danger, then call or text 9-8-8 for thoughts of suicide; Nisa Helpline is described as peer support, not a crisis line

guide:how-mentoring-works.title: How mentoring works and our conduct standards
keyPoints: Promises every mentor gives a written application, two contacted references, an interview and a masjid check before any match; confirm this is in place
Code of conduct: no marriage proposals or matchmaking, no money, no recruiting, privacy kept, same-gender mentoring by default
Says every mentor completes at least two hours of training, incl. Islamwise's 'A Guide to New Muslim Mentoring'; confirm Islamwise is suitable
States publicly that Vulnerable Sector Check eligibility and the final approver role are still undecided
In-person rules: public place, another adult present, no home visits or car meetings; reports go to coordinators via the Get help page
Says the standards follow MENTOR and Volunteer Canada benchmarks adapted for adult volunteers

guide:how-muslims-marry.title: How Muslims marry
keyPoints: Wali: says the Maliki, Shafi'i and Hanbali schools require one; Hanafi validates an adult woman's own contract (AMJA 87635); AMJA Family Code art. 18
Witnesses: AMJA Family Code art. 55 (two Muslim men) vs SeekersGuidance 2025 (or one man and two women); summary says a nikah 'needs' witnesses and mahr
New Muslim woman without Muslim paternal relatives: AMJA art. 19 names an arbitrator or community-appointed, state-licensed officiant, or a delegated Muslim man
Provincial rules: Ontario licence or banns; Quebec 20-day notice (Educaloi); BC and Alberta officiants registered with Vital Statistics
Mahr: BC and Ontario courts enforced some agreements, one Ontario court declined (Raman 2024); Ontario religious arbitration has no effect (2006 Act)
Hadith: Abu Dawud 2085 (sahih), Tirmidhi 1101, Bukhari 5167, 5090; 2025 Yaqeen: 70% married across race or ethnicity; barriers 51%, 32%, 25%

guide:young-converts.title: If you are under 18
keyPoints: Says a teen's Shahada is valid without a masjid or certificate; quotes SeekersGuidance (2023): 'don't worry about being unable to cover, fast, or attend a mosque'
Says you obey parents in everything except disobeying God (SeekersGuidance 2010); advises 'not lying to them without a real need'
Ontario (JFCY): at 15 or under parents decide where you live; at 16 or 17 you can leave parental control without a court order
Says an adult who helps a young person leave home can face criminal charges
Kids Help Phone 1-800-668-6868 or text CONNECT to 686868; Children's Aid Society; 911 in danger
Grooming red flags: secret chats or meetings, talk of marriage or a secret nikah, offers of housing or money, requests for photos

guide:children-and-family-life.title: Children and family life
keyPoints: Divorce Act s.16: only best interests count, the child's safety first, religious upbringing weighed; since 2021 'parenting arrangements' replace custody/access
Ontario PPM 162: Grades 1-8 exemption from sexual health expectations; says schools notify parents at least 20 school days ahead, form each year
Direct help with another religion's rite not allowed (SeekersGuidance 2021, baptism example); driving a parent to church not sinful if no one else (Darul Uloom TT)
SeekersGuidance 2017: a convert must care for her non-Muslim mother, give monthly sadaqah and visit weekly; Quran 17:23-24 and 31:15
Says AMJA Family Code arts. 206-211 custody rules are not what Canadian courts apply; Legal Aid Ontario 1-800-668-8258
Says it helps no one to tell a child that a parent is going to Hell; co-parenting advice from SeekersGuidance 2025 (Quran 66:6)

guide:travelling-as-a-muslim.title: Travelling as a Muslim
keyPoints: Plane prayer (Faraz Rabbani, Hanafi): pray in time, stand if reasonably able, else seated with a real prostration if possible; schools differ on repeating
Kosher: Hanafi and Hanbali require God's name over each animal, Shafi'i recommend it, some Malikis only for Muslims; answer concludes kosher can be eaten
Says eating pescatarian while halal meat is hard to find is fair (SeekersGuidance, checked by Abdul-Rahim Reasat); ask mainly about shared fryers
Toronto Pearson Terminal 1 multi-faith chapel: before security, Level 1 Arrivals; confirm location and access
Says a prayer mat is not required; a clean towel or jacket is enough
preCheckFlags: Related link 'Qibla finder' leads with Arabic; the site nav calls the tool 'Prayer direction (qibla)'

guide:when-someone-dies.title: When someone dies: what to do and who to call
keyPoints: Janazah per IslamQA: four takbirs with Al-Fatihah, blessings on the Prophet, dua, then salam; says schools differ on the first takbir's words and number of salams
Ontario paperwork: doctor or NP completes the Medical Certificate of Death, a Statement of Death, municipality registers and issues the burial permit
Says an Ontario coroner's autopsy decision is legal and binding and families should raise religious timing needs early
BC Act s.5-6: executor decides first; written preference binds unless unreasonable, impracticable or a hardship; Ontario rule stated as unconfirmed
IslamWeb: a convert carries no sin if family cremates her against her will; says 'Muslims do not cremate'
Names the Scarborough Muslim Association funeral service as an example (body release, washing, burial permit, cemetery); confirm details

guide:having-a-baby.title: Having a baby as a new Muslim
keyPoints: Adhan in the ear: Abu Dawud 5105 (Hasan per Al-Albani), Tirmidhi 1514 (hasan sahih), Darussalam Da'if; says whispering the name is not established sunnah
Aqiqah (IslamWeb): confirmed sunnah if affordable, two sheep for a boy, one for a girl, day 7, 14 or 21 or before puberty; not a debt
Circumcision: schools differ (recommended vs required); CPS Feb 2021 handout: not routine, no provincial plan pays for religious reasons; statement retired
Says 23% of recent mothers reported PPD or anxiety symptoms (Health Canada, 2018/2019 Survey on Maternal Health)
Crisis order: 911 in immediate danger, then call or text 9-8-8 if thinking about suicide; tahnik advice says ask a midwife before any food
Recommended acts (adhan and iqamah, tahnik, naming, head shave and charity, aqiqah) come from a Shafi'i SeekersGuidance answer
preCheckFlags: Heading 'Sunnah, custom and what can wait' leads with Arabic instead of plain English

guide:facing-hate-and-harassment.title: Facing hate and harassment
keyPoints: Says Statistics Canada recorded 229 police-reported anti-Muslim hate crimes in 2024; a 2019 survey found only 22% of hate-motivated incidents reported
Crime Stoppers 1-800-222-8477, anonymous with no caller ID; NCCM confirms reports within seven days and shares nothing without consent
RCMP definitions: a hate crime is a criminal offence motivated by bias, a hate incident is non-criminal; says both are worth reporting
Human rights routes: provincial agency for housing, services, schools and non-federal workplaces; Ontario Code covers renting, stores, schools, transit
Leaves to a scholar whether a woman may change or remove hijab when afraid; cites Naved Bakali (University of Windsor) on hijab-related abuse
After-effects: Justice Canada Victim Services Directory by postal code; 9-8-8 for thoughts of suicide at any time

guide:coming-back.title: Coming back after a break
keyPoints: Summary says the four schools' relied-upon positions require making up prayers missed after knowing; body cites Muhammad Fayez Awad and Ibn Rushd

Quotes Quran 39:53 in Dr. Mustafa Khattab's translation and cites Muslim 2749; Roohi Tahir (Yaqeen) on repentance as a way of life
